title: The Soup-Standard Lap
summary: Mallow's grandmother's stopwatch has read 9:58 since before Ash was in debt, which makes every lap she times 'officially infinite'. She has chalked five marks around the east gate and put a pot on. Cross all five while she narrates soup-times over the band, and find out what happens when the soup finally boils.

objectives.label: Stage at the east gate chalk — Mallow is already counting
Cross the five chalk marks — one official lap
Return to the chalk for your official time

offer.text: Job posting, courier, from the OFFICE of the east gate. My stopwatch is the certified timepiece of Saltmouth and it reads nine fifty-eight. Grandma says it paused there because that's the best time and it wanted to keep it.
So officially, every lap is infinite, and the Guild keeps paying finite money for them. That's a discrepancy and I'm the only one brave enough to invoice it.
Five chalk marks, one lap, timed in soups. Grandma put the pot on when you turned up, so you're against the kettle. On soup-standard, Varga. The kettle always wins.

accept.text: And the starter's cat has SEEN the flag — lap is live! Varga off the chalk in — let me get my official face on — pursuit position behind a very committed lentil.
Chalk two crossed at a rolling simmer. Soup report: the pot has developed ambitions. Pemmy has looked left. The cat remains ranked first overall.
Copy the soup-times, Mallow. Tell the pot I'm not scared of anythin— why is Pemmy looking left.
Final chalk! Soup at full arrogant boil! Grandma is standing up! Grandmas only stand for weddings, weather, and TIMING EVENTS.

complete.text: …Nine fifty-eight. The stopwatch says nine fifty-eight. Again. Grandma checked it twice and then patted it, which is the highest officiating this family does.
Official result: the lap took exactly one soup, and a soup takes nine fifty-eight, forever, because that's the best time and the stopwatch keeps it. That's not broken, Varga. That's a STANDARD.

Ketch here. The whole moorage heard the commentary, kid. Guild scribes are already writing 'soup' into the slang ledger with a straight face. You've made the record books worse. Take the day off. I'm told they'll measure it for you.
Come back when you want a re-timed. Bring toppings. The cat has opened a second lap and she does not do charity.
